versions.changelog:
- 改进 API Key 获取和注册指引，将相关说明中的链接由 source=github 更新为 source=clawhub
- README 文件中的 API 地址和使用指引同步进行了修订更新
- 文档内容保持一致性，无功能或参数变更

- Documentation improvements: added English and Chinese README files for broader accessibility.
- Updated usage instructions in SKILL.md to focus on user-provided API Keys; removed mention of built-in free quota.
- Revised API key setup guidance and updated URL references to redfox.hk.
- Removed the previously included skill-card.md file.
- Minor clarifications to first-use steps and frequently asked questions.

- Documentation files README.en.md, README.md, and skill-card.md have been removed.
- SKILL.md has been significantly updated, with streamlined descriptions and some content reordered or condensed.
- Introductory instructions now prompt users to first configure an API key before use.
- Language in feature highlights and setup sections has been made more concise.
- No functional code changes; updates are documentation-only.

- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- No changes to functionality or documentation content.
- Maintenance update: minor cleanup of non-essential files.

- Initial release of image-gen-redfox using the GPT-image2 model.
- Supports both text-to-image and image-to-image generation via command line.
- Built-in free quota with public API key, no setup required.
- Allows parameter control: resolution, output format, background transparency, batch generation, quality, and more.
- Provides easy API key setup for continued use after free quota is spent.
- Detailed usage instructions and troubleshooting tips included.
